facts: Dress Down Day is Friday, September 25, 2026.
Families may donate any amount; all proceeds support a local charity.
Dress Down Day will occur twice each month, with future dates appearing on the school calendar beginning in October.

documents.label: October 2026 ABVM school calendar
facts: October 2026 ABVM school calendar lists picture/HSA activities, schedule changes, Mass/communication dates, clubs, family events, dress-down days, and the Halloween celebration.
Grade 2-relevant schedule changes include winter uniform beginning Oct. 4; progress reports Oct. 8; noon dismissal Oct. 9; no school Oct. 12 and Oct. 20; and K–4 flag football/dress down Oct. 26.
Chick-fil-A orders and money are due Oct. 9; the calendar lists delivery Oct. 22 from 2:45–4:30 PM.

documents.label: October 2026 ABVM lunch menu
facts: The October 2026 lunch menu is for Assumption BVM School and is provided by Saint Clair Area School District.
The printed menu covers Oct. 1–30 and lists no lunch on Oct. 9 for noon dismissal and no school on Oct. 12.
The full transcribed October menu is stored in lunch-catalog.json.

documents.label: Chick-fil-A order form — October 2026
facts: Chick-fil-A orders cost $7.00 each.
Orders and money are due Friday, Oct. 9, 2026.
Delivery/pickup is Thursday, Oct. 22, 2026 from 3:00–4:30 PM at Assumption BVM School; orders can be picked up at dismissal.

documents.label: Flag football and food-bank dress-down notice
facts: K–4 flag football is Monday, Oct. 26 from 1:45–2:30 PM during the school day; each grade plays its own grade.
K–4 Dress Down Day is Monday, Oct. 26; participation requires either a requested food-bank item or a $5 donation.
Flag football permission forms are due Wednesday, Oct. 7.
Grades 5–8 have their own flag football and dress-down day Thursday, Oct. 29.

documents.label: Personal birthday-party invitation — privacy-redacted
facts: A personal birthday party is Sunday, Oct. 18 from 12:30–3:30 PM at Roller Roost Sports Arena.
RSVP is requested by Saturday, Oct. 10.
Direct contact information, the invited child’s name, age, and the street address are intentionally omitted from the public app.

documents.label: Weekly reminders for October 5–9, 2026
facts: Monday, Oct. 5: Raise Right physical gift card order; the Door Decorating Contest has begun.
Tuesday, Oct. 6: Faculty Meeting is 3–4 PM; flag football sign-ups are due.
Wednesday, Oct. 7: Mass for St. John the Baptist is at 9 AM.

Friday, Oct. 9: 12:00 dismissal; Chick-fil-A orders are due; the conference schedule portal closes.

Upcoming reminders include no school Oct. 12; Dress Down Day for the Knights of Columbus Thanksgiving Meal Oct. 13; Mass and Communication Folder Oct. 14; Parent-Teacher Conferences Oct. 19–20; Mass Oct. 21; Chick-fil-A delivery Oct. 22; Lego Club and S'Mores Family Oct. 23; K–4 Dress Down Day/flag football Oct. 26; grades 5–8 Dress Down Day/flag football Oct. 29; and the Halloween Celebration Oct. 30.

documents.label: St. Nicholas Seahawks CYO basketball flyer
facts: St. Nicholas Seahawks CYO basketball registration is open.
Programs are co-ed for kindergarten/1st grade and for 2nd grade, and all children are welcome.
The program is held at St. Nicholas School Gymnasium in Minersville, Pennsylvania.
The sign-up fee is $25.
2nd grade registration: https://tools.signupgenius.com/c/st-nicholas-basketball-registration-k-1st-grade-copy
Kindergarten/1st grade registration: https://tools.signupgenius.com/c/st-nicholas-basketball-registration

The October 1 prize was for Cracker Barrel; the October 2 prize was for Roman Delight.
Winner and seller names are intentionally omitted from the public app.
